description: MBRC Planning Scheme - Flood Hazard Overlay is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Version 20 June 2016 The Flood Hazard Overlay is part of the Moreton Bay Regional Council Planning Scheme. MBRC Planning Scheme will help to respond to growth and development across the Moreton Bay Region. It is a statutory document regulating how land can be used and developed. Coverage: City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The portal files it under the publisher City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Its tags are autogen, creek, flood, flooding, hazard. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
